content: Past the perimeter wattle fence of Southfall, the mountain sloped down into a ravine choked with frozen blackberry thorns and silver-barked birch trees. A trickle of clear spring water seeped from between two granite boulders, steaming faintly in the pre-dawn frost. The air tasted of pine needles, wet moss, and bitter mountain minerals.
critique: Sanderson: Strong biological limits and mechanical vector precision.
